bio.text: Rob Clifton, a Republican from Evans, represents District 131 in the Georgia House of Representatives and was first elected in 2024.
According to The Augusta Press in 2024, Clifton is the CEO and owner of Clifton Construction, an Auburn University graduate and a father of two.

sources.title: Rep. Rob Clifton Sworn in, Receives Committee Assignments for the 2025-2026 Legislative Term
Local builder explains his candidacy for District 131
